description.value: Gon Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Chilliwack serving sushi rolls, sashimi, tempura, teriyaki, and Korean-influenced dishes such as bulgogi bibimbob. It offers both pickup and delivery, making it a practical meal stop for cyclists travelling the Vedder Road corridor. The menu spans appetizers through specialty rolls and full rice plates.
